judge.rationale: The candidate accurately implements the core usage accumulation logic across tool rounds, handles missing usage rounds gracefully, and satisfies all acceptance criteria in the ticket. To make the hook signature unambiguous as requested, the candidate introduces a new `TotalUsageMetadata` type alias/interface, whereas the reference simply renames the parameter to `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`. The candidate also fails to update the doc-block for `OrchestratorHooks` in `specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md` and `CLAUDE.md` to reflect its changed signature (`usage?: TotalUsageMetadata`), and places the new `afterModelResponse` behavior under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` rather than moving it to the main spec section as the reference did. Additionally, the candidate creates a separate acceptance test file and leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the tree instead of placing all tests alongside existing tool-loop tests in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
